reason: Avoid unnecessary consumption of finite shield when renewable protection already blocks the same attempt, while preserving the individual duration and consumption rules.

rule: Ferry selection reserves up to remaining two distinct lifetime passenger slots; actual lethal deferral consumes one. Unused marks expire at day close, unused passengers may be selected again. Prolonged persons retain public discussion/vote, count alive until day closure; settle expiry after hanging and before victory; process real death/seed at expiry.
reason: Preserve rescue precedence and finite successful passenger quota without wasting a charge on a rescued or unattacked target.
rollback: Disable new candidate admission; no rule change to historical non-composed games.

reason: Prevent target-list, delivery-result and gameplay revision oracles about hidden hibernation; preserve ability to address publicly dead players.
